text: At least 1 measurable lesion according to RECIST 1.1.

text: Fertile female patients must voluntarily use effective contraceptives not less than 120 days after chemotherapy or the last dose of toripalimab (whichever is later) during the study period, and urine or serum pregnancy test results within 7 days prior to enrollment are negative.

text: Patients with a malignancy other than NSCLC within five years prior to the start of this trial，except for cured basal cell carcinoma of the skin, early gastrointestinal (GI) carcinoma excised through endoscopy, cervical carcinoma in situ, ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast, papillary thyroid carcinoma, or any cured cancer deemed to have no impact on the survival of the current NSCLC;

ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast

text: Participants with any unstable systemic disease (including active infection, uncontrolled hypertension), unstable angina pectoris, angina pectoris starting in the last three months, congestive heart failure (>= NYHA) Grade II), myocardial infarction (6 months before admission), severe arrhythmia requiring drug treatment, liver, kidney or metabolic diseases;

evaluation.explanation: The criterion describes various medical conditions not covered by the schema, so custom fields are appropriate. The OR logic correctly captures the ‘any of these conditions’ exclusion semantics.

text: Patients with congenital or acquired immune dysfunction (such as HIV infected individuals);

text: Received other major surgical treatments (excluding diagnosis) within 4 weeks prior to the start of the study or expected to undergo major surgical treatments during the study period;

evaluation.explanation: The logical condition (OR of recent or expected major surgery) matches the exclusion meaning, but the schema provides a 'treatments' field that should capture surgical history; using custom fields instead is a misuse of the defined schema.

text: Participants who are allergic to the test drug or any auxiliary materials;

text: A history of extensive diffuse bilateral interstitial fibrosis in the past or before medication, or a known grade 3 or 4 history of interstitial fibrosis or interstitial lung disease, including pneumonia, allergic pneumonia, interstitial pneumonia, interstitial lung disease, obliterative bronchiolitis, and pulmonary fibrosis, but not including local radiation pneumonia or radiation pulmonary fibrosis history;

evaluation.explanation: The criterion concerns interstitial lung disease, which has no corresponding schema field, so custom fields are appropriate. The OR logic correctly captures both the extensive fibrosis history and grade 3‑4 fibrosis condition.
